headline: Eastman Chemical Q3 Slides Show Margin Gains Despite Revenue Miss
summary: Eastman Chemical reported Q3 2026 earnings slides showing profit margin improvements, although the company missed consensus revenue estimates.
why: Specialty chemical producers monitor margin expansions closely as an indicator of pricing power and cost management amid volatile input expenses.

impacts.name: Eastman Chemical
impacts.why: Margin gains offset the negative impact of missing revenue expectations.
